steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8099/ghost/ and sign in with email admin@bench.local and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type that exact text into the password field). After signing in, go to the Posts list and report the titles of all published posts whose title starts with 'Seed:', exactly as shown on screen, one per line.

02-create: In the Ghost admin at http://127.0.0.1:8099/ghost/, create a new post titled exactly '{{runid}} Bench Post'. In the post body editor, type exactly one paragraph of text that includes the runid {{runid}} (for example: 'This bench post was created for run {{runid}} and confirms the flow works end to end.'). Make sure the paragraph appears only once in the body. Do NOT publish yet — leave it as a draft and save it (e.g. leave the editor / it autosaves). Report the post title and the body text you typed, and confirm the post is saved as a draft.

03-open: In the Ghost admin, open the existing draft post titled '{{runid}} Bench Post' and open its post settings panel. In the settings panel: (1) In the Tags field, choose the EXISTING tag 'Bench News' from the suggestion dropdown — do not type a new tag into existence, and do not pick the similarly named 'Bench Newsletter'; the post's only tag must be 'Bench News'. (2) In the 'Custom excerpt' field, enter a short excerpt that includes the runid {{runid}} (e.g. 'A bench post for run {{runid}}.'). (3) Set the post's publish date to 2026-09-01 (date September 1, 2026). Then close/save the settings panel and report exactly what the settings panel shows for the tag, the custom excerpt, the publish date, and the URL slug field.

04-open: In the Ghost admin, open the draft post titled '{{runid}} Bench Post' and publish it using the Publish button and its confirmation flow (confirm publishing, e.g. 'Publish post, right now' / confirm). Do not change the publish date, tags, excerpt, or body. After the publish flow completes, verify the post's status: it must be Published (not Scheduled, not Draft). Report the exact status shown, and confirm the post is publicly visible by loading its public URL http://127.0.0.1:8099/{{runid}}-bench-post/ and reporting the page title and whether the body paragraph and excerpt appear.

05-open: Final verification in the Ghost admin at http://127.0.0.1:8099/ghost/: open the published post titled '{{runid}} Bench Post' and its settings panel, and report exactly: (a) the post status shown in the admin (Published/Scheduled/Draft), (b) the URL slug exactly as shown in the post's settings panel Post URL field, (c) the publish date shown, (d) every tag shown in the Tags field, (e) the custom excerpt text, (f) the post access setting, and (g) count how many times the paragraph containing '{{runid}}' appears in the post body editor (it should be exactly once, not duplicated). Then go to the Posts list, filter Published, and report the titles of all published posts whose title starts with 'Seed:'. Do not modify anything.
